fail_closed.rule: Missing, empty, or bare-scheme app gRPC credential headers stamp no credential; the facade AppInstall gate then resolves the caller through membership and denies when authority is required.
An invalid or unauthorized active-tenant assertion on the apps gRPC surface fails before app registry, source, consent, or activation metadata is read.
Missing, empty, or bare-scheme credential headers resolve to anonymous or null and downstream gates deny when authority is required.
Missing, blank, or syntactically invalid active-tenant headers stamp no active tenant; unauthorized assertions validate to the uninitialized tenant and fail closed at composition or gate seams.

An app tool grant is checked again at invocation against the current registry and access gate; disabling the app or revoking the compiled grant causes the tool call to fail even if it was listed earlier in the session.

The MCP region catalog re-resolves an asserted active tenant through ITenantContextResolver and honours it only on an exact match; a refused or unvalidatable assertion yields the current region alone with no tenantScope annotation.
